title: Enterprise-HQ-and-WAN-Figure-4-7
desc: Complete Enterprise HQ & WAN Infrastructure Deployment featuring Dual-Homed WAN Routers (R3/R4), HQ Edge Gateways (AR1/AR2), Layer 3 Core Switches (LSW2/LSW3 with VRRP & MSTP), Layer 2 Access Switch (LSW1), USG Firewall Security Perimeter, WLAN Access Controller (AC), Fit APs (AP1/AP2), and Wired/Wireless Terminals.
tasks: 1. Layer 2 Switching: Configure VLAN 10 (Wired Users), VLAN 20 (Wireless Users), VLAN 30 (Management/AP), and VLAN 100 (Server/Firewall).
2. Core Link Aggregation: Configure Eth-Trunk 1 in Static LACP mode between LSW2 and LSW3.
3. Gateway High Availability: Configure VRRP on Vlanif 10 and Vlanif 20 with LSW2 as Master (Priority 120) and LSW3 as Backup (Priority 100).
4. WLAN Controller & APs: Configure DHCP Option 43 on LSW2 for AP CAPWAP discovery, and configure SSID 'Enterprise-HQ-WiFi' on AC.
5. Edge Routing: Configure OSPF Multi-Area between AR1, AR2, LSW2, and LSW3, with Default Route injection towards WAN R3/R4.
6. Firewall Security: Configure USG Security Zones (Trust: LAN, Untrust: WAN) and interzone security policies permiting outbound traffic with NAT.

AC-Wireless: security wpa2 psk pass-phrase Huawei@123 aes

On FW-USG: Run 'display firewall session table' to verify stateful packet filtering.
